Organizers

Conference

A three-day international forum on zakat and philanthropy

Date
24 – 26 November 2026Add to Google Calendar →
Venue
Faculty of Economics and Management (FEM), IPB Dramaga Campus, BogorOpen in Google Maps →
Theme
From Local Impact to Global Solidarity: The Future of Zakat and Philanthropy

Participants

The conference aims to invite 300 participants from both domestic and international backgrounds, including:

  1. 01Practitioners from Zakat Management Agencies, including BAZNAS, LAZ, and International Zakat Institutions
  2. 02Academics (lecturers and students) and researchers
  3. 03Officials and staff from relevant government agencies
  4. 04Stakeholders from non-governmental organizations (NGOs)
  5. 05Other zakat stakeholders
  6. 06The general public

Conference events

The conference will feature various sub-events, including:

  1. 01

    International Conference

  2. 02

    Paper and Book Chapter Presentation

  3. 03

    Book Launching
